title: Verdant Ruins: The Cartographer's Civic Seed
premise: In a forest city reclaimed by root-powered civic machines, the cartographer must chart hidden passages before nightfall using a living contour chart.
ending: Recover the Civic Seed and return with the charted evacuation line; Green Assembly can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive spore plume while evading the canopy defender without sacrificing the charted evacuation line.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Green Assembly to witness the living contour chart.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to publish an unsafe shortcut
